title: The Locked Vault
subtitle: hideDetailsUntilStartable
description: A locked quest whose card shows no tasks and no rewards: `hideDetailsUntilStartable`
keeps the detail page shut until the quest can actually be started, so a locked
quest cannot be read ahead of time.
REQUIRES stays on the card while it is shut, deliberately -- the prerequisites are
the one thing a player needs from a locked quest, because they are what says how to
unlock it. Open this one while it is locked and see what is left.
